A `sed` command adjusts include paths from <slang/ to <shader-slang/, which aligns with the package depending on the system-provided 'shader-slang' library instead of bundling it—this is a legitimate build adaptation.

All build steps use standard CMake workflows, and installation proceeds via `cmake --install` into the package directory. Files are installed to appropriate system locations: desktop file to `/usr/share/applications`, icon to hicolor theme directory, and binaries/libs via CMake install. The checksums are set to 'SKIP', which is normal and expected for VCS-based AUR packages. There are no network operations during build, no use of eval or obfuscated code, and no suspicious file manipulations outside the build and package directories.

No evidence of malicious behavior was found. The modifications are transparent, limited in scope, and serve clear packaging purposes consistent with Arch Linux and AUR standards.
</details>
